title: 美国忙着遏制中国AI：中国却说不想争霸权，到底谁在怕什么
speaker: Xiaoyu Chun

segments.en: The second is so far within the AI sector, the United States is still considering a lot about its competition with China. So it wants very much to contain China's development in AI sector.
segments.zh: 第二，到目前为止，在人工智能领域，美国仍在大量考虑与中国的竞争。所以它非常想遏制中国在人工智能领域的发展。

segments.en: So I just read the news that the President said they had a talk about the export control issue with the Chinese side. So it's about the Chinese rights of development in the AI sector. So this has also been a very big challenge for the China-US AI dialogue in the future.
segments.zh: 我刚读到新闻，总统说他们与中方谈了出口管制问题。这关乎中国在人工智能领域的发展权利。所以这也是未来中美人工智能对话的一个非常大的挑战。

segments.en: But anyway, it's a good start. That's a very good point to make because one side, the US, views the other as a competitor. Well, the other side, China doesn't, at least on optics, I doesn't seem to be looking at it through the same lens-utron.
segments.zh: 但无论如何，这是一个好的开始。这是一个很好的观点，因为一方美国将另一方视为竞争对手。而另一方中国，至少从表面看，似乎并不以同样的视角看待。

segments.en: Can you enlighten us a little bit? How that is framed in China? What do they see the US as a rival and strategic rival when it comes to AI specifically? Just tell us more about what you know.
segments.zh: 您能稍微启发我们一下吗？在中国是如何表述的？在人工智能方面，他们是否将美国视为对手和战略对手？请多告诉我们一些您所了解的情况。

segments.en: Here, the Chinese perception is, of course, we have a lot of competition with the US on the AI sector, science, technology who runs fast, you know, all those things. It's a competition. But it's not like the strategic competition that a lot of Washingtonians are talking about.
segments.zh: 在中方看来，当然，我们在人工智能领域、科技领域与美国有很多竞争，谁跑得快，诸如此类。这是竞争。但这不像许多华盛顿人士谈论的那种战略竞争。

segments.en: China does not want to use the AR as a tool to replace the United States as the only Hedgemont country in the world. So it's quite different.
segments.zh: 中国不想把人工智能作为工具来取代美国成为世界上唯一的霸权国家。所以这非常不同。

segments.en: And here, a lot of people are looking for real cooperation, exchanges with the US side, with all those high tech companies in the Silicon Valley, in those universities that talents the scientists, the experts need to have dialogue and exchanges to develop AI technology. But right now, they are facing a lot of obstacles, right?
segments.zh: 在这里，很多人正在寻求与美方、与硅谷所有高科技公司、与那些大学进行真正的合作与交流，人才、科学家、专家需要对话和交流来发展人工智能技术。但目前，他们面临很多障碍，对吧？
